title: Queue Steward Dashboard
description: Agent queue monitoring dashboard for SigNoz observability

widgets.title: Queue Depth Overview
widgets.description: Current queue depth with color-coded thresholds

query.query: SELECT count() FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE position(body, 'agent_queue') > 0

widgets.title: Ready vs Pending Jobs
widgets.description: Time series showing ready and pending job counts

query.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'readyCount')) AS ready_count, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'pendingCount')) AS pending_count FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE position(body, 'agent_queue') > 0 AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT any(JSONExtractBool(body, 'killSwitch')) AS kill_switch_active FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE position(body, 'agent_queue') > 0 AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT JSONExtractString(body, 'lanes') AS lanes_data, fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) AS ts FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE position(body, 'agent_queue') > 0 AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT toStartOfMinute(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'queueLength')) AS avg_queue_depth FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE position(body, 'agent_queue') > 0 AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

widgets.title: Agent Health
widgets.description: Current agent status and job processing metrics

query.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(body, 'agentName') AS agent_name, JSONExtractInt(body, 'jobsProcessed') AS jobs_processed, JSONExtractString(body, 'lastRun') AS last_run FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE position(body, 'agent_queue') > 0 AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
